intro.label: Contact
intro.title: Tell me what you're running.
intro.lede: Could be a whole network rebuild, could be one plugin that refuses to behave. Message me on any of these and I'll tell you honestly whether I'm the right person for it.

channels.label: Discord
channels.note: Easily the best way to reach me. I read everything and usually answer the same day, UTC+1.

channels.label: Email
channels.note: Better for longer briefs, quotes, or anything with files attached.

channels.label: BuiltByBit
channels.note: If you'd rather work through platform escrow, that suits me fine.
